[SQP-2] expected: Sending text, article URLs, X URLs, slide content, and image URLs to PostNitro is central to the skill, but the artifacts would benefit from a clearer privacy warning before external submission.
[SQP-2] expected: The API reference documents the external endpoints and request fields, but does not separately warn users not to submit confidential or regulated material.
[E1] expected: External transmission to https://embed-api.postnitro.ai is explicit, limited to the stated PostNitro workflow, and not paired with evidence of unrelated exfiltration.
llm.guidance: Before installing, verify you trust the publisher and PostNitro account you are connecting. Use a scoped or dedicated API key if possible, expect carousel generation to spend credits, and do not submit private drafts, internal URLs, personal data, secrets, or regulated content unless you are authorized to send it to PostNitro.
